## v2.3.3 — Filter expressions in tag arguments

- All built-in tags now support filter chains in their arguments:
  `{% set %}`, `{% with %}`, `{% for %}`, `{% cycle %}`, `{% firstof %`,
  `{% ifchanged %}`, `{% now %}`, `{% if %}`, `{% include %}`,
  `{% partial %}`, `{% extends %}`, `{% blocktrans %}`, `{% trans %}`.
- Multiple filters can be chained in a single tag argument, e.g.
  `{% set x = "hello"|upper|lower %}`.
- Fixed `{% with %}` parser so values containing `|` are preserved
  instead of being truncated.
- Fixed `{% firstof %}` parser to keep filter expressions as single
  tokens so `{% firstof "" "world"|upper %}` evaluates correctly.
- Codegen path (`src/codegen.js`) now evaluates tag-argument filters
  inline, so compiled templates support the same syntax without runtime
  parser overhead.

CI: lint + tests passing (410/410).
